name: Sensarat
look: a round, shaggy brown rat with a cream face, closed eyes, big round ears, very long dark feeler whiskers and a long pink tail
entry: It sweeps its long whiskers through the dark like feelers and senses an attack before it comes, striking first. It never opens its eyes; those who have seen them say they are as bright as stars.
how: Evolve Mousense at level 22. It learns Sucker Punch when it evolves.
Wild: uncommon in plains and forests.
